description: This file defines the DocumentVersion class, representing an embedded document version with associated metadata such as version number, creation timestamp, notes, storage reference, OCR text, and category.

classes.name: DocumentVersion
classes.description: Represents a specific version of a document with metadata including version number, creation time, notes, storage reference, OCR text, and category.

methods.name: DocumentVersion()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty DocumentVersion instance.

methods.name: DocumentVersion(int, String, String, String, String)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for initializing a DocumentVersion with specific values.

methods.name: getVersionNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the version number of the document.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the creation timestamp of the document version.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with this document version.

methods.name: getStorageRef
methods.description: Retrieves the storage reference (blob/file storage ref).

methods.name: getOcrText
methods.description: Retrieves the OCR text associated with this document version.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves the category assigned to this document version.

methods.name: setNotes
methods.description: Sets the notes for this document version.
